description: List the game and server settings for a specific instance (by id or exact name), with their current values. These are the same validated settings the panel's settings pages expose, and are the correct way to read configuration. Prefer this over reading raw config files, which are game-specific and lossy to rewrite. Returns each setting's field id, label, page, current value, whether it can be changed, and the allowed options where the setting is a choice.

editable_only.description: Return only settings that can be changed with set_settings. Defaults to false, which also lists read-only and display values.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

limit.description: Maximum number of settings to return (1-300). Defaults to 100. Narrow with `page` or `search` rather than raising this.

page.description: Only return settings on this page id (as returned in a setting's `page`). Omit to return settings from every page.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against the field id and label. Use this to find a specific setting the user described in their own words.

name: get_settings
title: Get Instance Settings
